{{Current events|year=2019|month=11|day=21|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Bolivian protests]]
**[[Law enforcement in Bolivia|Bolivian]] [[riot police]] fire [[tear gas]] to break up a [[funeral procession]] that had turned into massive anti-[[Government of Bolivia|government]] protest. [https://www.france24.com/en/20191121-police-break-up-bolivia-funeral-protest-as-congress-meets-on-elections (France 24)] [https://www.ibtimes.com/police-break-bolivia-funeral-protest-congress-meets-elections-2871174 (International Business Times)] [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-bolivia-politics/supporters-of-bolivias-morales-march-with-coffins-of-dead-protesters-idUKKBN1XV1P5 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Two [[United States Air Force|USAF]] airmen are killed when [[mid-air collision|two planes collide]] at [[Vance Air Force Base]] in [[Enid, Oklahoma]], [[United States]]. [https://www.abc12.com/content/news/Vance-Air-Force-Base-Okla-says-2-aircraft-involved-in-mishap-565283912.html (Associated Press)]
*An explosion at a [[fireworks]] factory in the town of [[Barcellona Pozzo di Gotto]], [[Sicily]], [[Italy]], kills five people and injures two others. [https://news.sky.com/story/five-people-killed-in-explosion-at-fireworks-factory-in-sicily-11866146 (Sky News)]

;International relations
*[[Cross-Strait relations]]
**After the [[2020 Taiwan presidential election|running mate for the presidency of Taiwan]] for [[Tsai Ing-wen]], [[William Lai]], says he supports [[Taiwanese independence]], [[China]] condemns the move as a "disaster" which crosses a red line China is not willing to accept. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-taiwan-election/china-says-taiwan-courting-disaster-after-pre-election-comment-on-independence-idUSKBN1XV0LU (Reuters)] 
;Law and crime
*[[2019 Hong Kong protests]]
**The [[Hong Kong High Court]] denies the lift of a travel ban imposed on [[pro-democracy]] activist [[Joshua Wong]], who was scheduled to travel to the [[United Kingdom]] to receive a [[human rights]] award from the two houses of the [[British Parliament]]. The judge cites the risk of absconding and says he can remain in the city to help restore peace. [http://theindependent.sg/hk-court-forbids-joshua-wong-from-traveling-to-london-to-receive-human-rights-award-from-british-parliament/ (''The Independent'')]
*[[2019 Chilean protests]]
**[[Amnesty International]] releases a report regarding [[human rights violations]] committed by the [[Carabineros de Chile|Carabineros]] and the [[Chilean Armed Forces|Armed Forces]] against peaceful protesters. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-chile-protests-amnesty-idUSKBN1XV1J1?taid=5dd6b27cbd53880001eb7034 (Reuters)]
*[[Investigations involving Benjamin Netanyahu]]
**[[Prime Minister of Israel]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] is officially indicted by [[Attorney General of Israel|Attorney General]] [[Avichai Mandelblit]] for bribery, fraud, and breach of trust.  Netanyahu protests the allegations as being part of a political "[[witch-hunt]]" against him. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/nov/21/israeli-prime-minister-benjamin-netanyahu-indicted-for-bribery-and (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2019 Iranian fuel protests]]
**The [[Supreme National Security Council]] gradually restores the internet to some [[Provinces of Iran|provinces]] and parts of [[Tehran]], after [[Internet outage|shutting it off]] nationwide five days ago to counteract protests. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/iran-loosens-internet-restrictions-protest-shutdown-191121195539005.html (Al Jazeera)]
*Nine [[Extinction Rebellion]] protesters are arrested for storming U.S. House of Representatives Speaker [[Nancy Pelosi]]’s office. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/climate-environment/2019/11/21/nine-climate-activists-arrested-after-storming-nancy-pelosis-office/ (''Washington Post'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Vanuatu]] backtracks on a controversial law that would have allowed immigration authorities to [[Racial profiling|racially profile]] and closely follow people from the [[Middle East]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/403853/vanuatu-backtracks-on-special-profiling-immigration-policy (RNZ)]
*[[2019 Colombian protests]]
**Thousands of protestors take to the streets in [[Colombia]] demanding the resignation of [[President of Colombia|President]] [[Iván Duque Márquez]]. The protests were instigated over controversial tax and labor reforms proposed by [[Congress of Colombia|Congress]], murders of indigenous leaders, and the government’s failure to implement the [[Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia|FARC]] [[Colombian peace process|peace deal]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/with-nationwide-strike-colombia-joins-south-americas-season-of-protest/2019/11/21/2d3adf0e-0bef-11ea-8054-289aef6e38a3_story.html (''Washington Post'')]
